summary: This Office Action is a final rejection. Claims 1-3, 5, 8, and 10 are rejected under 35 U.S.C. 102(a)(1) as being anticipated by Wood (US 3,240,525), and claims 1 and 8 are rejected on the ground of nonstatutory double patenting over claims 1, 4, 7, and 12 of U.S. Patent No. 11,413,727.
